notes.title: MEET the Exosuit ES-1 "Wildcat"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]"Hello, brothers in arms![/p][p]Today we're back to two-legged vehicles; we'll be talking about the "small" [b]ES-1 "Wildcat"[/b] exosuit![/p][p][/p][p]At first glance, the Wildcat might look like a mech, but my intention is to make it an exosuit.[/p][p]The difference?[/p][p]A mech is something imposing, a sort of earth-shaking bipod tank, armed with powerful, sci-fi weapons.[/p][p]An exosuit is a sort of mini-mech, meaning it's much cheaper than a mech, much less armed and armored than a mech, but easier to use.[/p][p][/p][p]For a player, calling a mech onto the battlefield will cost credits.[/p][p]Calling an exosuit, on the other hand, should be a relatively cheap action, aimed at getting out of a difficult situation like being surrounded or countering a certain threat for which the player is not equipped.[/p][p][/p][p]In this case, the ES-1 Wildcat is designed for "anti-infantry" tasks, meaning the elimination of small, lightly armored enemies, thanks to its armament: a 7.62 mm rotary machine gun and a 40 mm grenade launcher.[/p][p]If you're surrounded by numerous ants or infantry without anti-tank weapons, calling in a Wildcat could save your life.[/p][p][/p][p]For this reason, I'd like to make deploying exosuits (yes, there will be more than one) much faster than calling in vehicles, coming close to calling the Titan in Titanfall.[/p][p][/p][p]What do you think?[/p][p]If you have any suggestions, please let me know; maybe an idea will emerge that will improve the game for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/4bd0d707dd78627a4f5c131c550cbc9abefbbce3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/22a574a04cb1f74f548ffb7f5c9adf5e3c995583.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f1c1124947b4e85f5e75f02842dbbf4d0ac53daa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/d23b6ad2a981dac733443919765fd98d3ea42c6f.png"][/img][/p]

There weren't many pictures in those books, so my imagination ran wild, and the real smell of salt air gave my imagination a more realistic feel.[/p][p][/p][p]Back to us, today I present to you the notes.title: ABOUT GAMEPLAY: unlocks and calls for vehicles
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]"Hello, soldiers![/p][p][b]Today I won't be showing you any new units, but I wanted to talk about a very specific game mechanic: how to use vehicles?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I want to clarify that I'll use the word "vehicles" for convenience, but by that I mean: vehicles, mechs, planes, helicopters, ships, boats, submarines, and any other metallic devilry I can think of.[/p][p][/p][p]In FPS/TPS games, there are generally two ways to use vehicles:[/p][p]1) You find them scattered around the map[/p][p]2) You summon them from outside the map[/p][p]Simple.[/p][p][/p][p]Personally, I find advantages and disadvantages in both methods:[/p][p]1) It's a democratic method of distributing vehicles, but it's frustrating if you want to use a single-seater plane and there are five other players in line before you (perhaps even good ones who never get shot down!). Furthermore, the variety of vehicles is inevitably limited, and you often have to make do with what you find.[/p][p]2) A "capitalist" way to use a vehicle, meaning if you have some kind of money, you can call it in; otherwise, you're completely on your own. The advantage is that you can call it in whenever you want, and you can call in the exact vehicle you want.[/p][p][/p][p]In "Home Wars: Battlefield," I'm trying to circumvent these problems by creating a hybrid system.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How does this hybrid system work?[/b][/h3][p]Basically, the player can call in the vehicle they want in battle, but there will also be other vehicles on the map, of random value, that the player and bots can use.[/p][p]Let me explain.[/p][p]During battle, the player will accumulate a sort of credits (I'm not sure how yet) that they can spend in the match to call in the vehicles they want. Obviously, better vehicles will cost more.[/p][p]Once spawned, these vehicles can be used by anyone and in any player/bot combination.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Can the player use all vehicles from the start of the game?[/b][/h3][p]No.[/p][p]At the end of each battle, depending on the outcome, players will receive another type of credit that they can spend to unlock new vehicles in a dedicated offline menu.[/p][p]The same goes for soldier weapons, insects, and dinosaurs.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Can you give us an example?[/b][/h3][p]I can give you an example.[/p][p]Let's say you and your trusty squad are surrounded by small, lightly armored insects, but desperate to exterminate humanity. You realize you're ill-equipped for such a fight, because you have a sniper rifle, one of your teammates has a sniper rifle, one uses only anti-tank weapons, and another enjoys setting mines and barricades.[/p][p]It doesn't take Napoleon to realize that you'll soon be cannon fodder.[/p][p]So, thanks to your unlocks, you can summon a nice modern tank onto the battlefield, perhaps equipped with a cannon, flamethrower, top turrets, and maybe even a nice mortar.[/p][p]That would be cool, right?[/p][p]You can do it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do you earn credits to unlock vehicles offline?[/b][/h3][p]As I said, they should be earned by winning battles and/or opening specific chests during combat.[/p][p]If you have any ideas, please share them![/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do you earn credits to summon vehicles into battle?[/b][/h3][p]Well, I don't know the exact method, but I have a variety of options. Tell me in the comments which one you think is best:[/p][p]- Credits accrue over time, regardless of whether the player is playing or looking for errors in the game and then giving me a bad review.[/p][p]- Credits are awarded based on your own: kills, damage inflicted, and objectives achieved.[/p][p]- Same as the previous point, but shared by the entire team.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Please give me your opinion; it's essential to me.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]What type of vehicle would you like to use most?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Lion"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, soldiers![/p][p]This week, we're starting with a bang![/p][p]I present to you a vehicle that is an icon of an era and a country: the "[b]Lion[/b]" heavy tank!!![/p][p][/p][p]You've almost certainly recognized it: it's the legendary Tiger 1, used by Germany during World War II![/p][p]This tank was a veritable bunker on tracks for its time, as feared as it was expensive to produce and maintain.[/p][p]At the time of its introduction, there was likely no other tank in the world capable of beating it in 1v1 combat, which is why its enemies had to surround and attack it simultaneously to overcome this metal beast.[/p][p][/p][p]In the game, the Lion will be a heavily armored heavy tank equipped with an 88 mm cannon and a pair of 7.62 mm machine guns.[/p][p]Its task will be to break through enemy lines head-on![/p][p]Will it be the most powerful tank in the game? No, it will probably be the more modern tanks, which will have many more weapons on board and slightly better armor. However, this beast will be less expensive than its more recent counterparts so that it can be used multiple times in the same battle.[/p][p][/p][p]Can you imagine using it in some joint tactics with our friends or rushing headlong into the enemy objective alone?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/aeb4facaf4cba336f1202f8d8af7e4a278b634c3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ca149c41a0dd30af2b92d03ded49f4051d29a45c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/3128a30f759b7ef785d0b7ad67c39f8ff47e1a66.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c522a1ed3dc7200c7d3ef85fd3528628ffbf8df7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/58b9ca9c6cb3eba66b41d9f50afe6f8d3a13a48c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/49e1ca8571429f284ac967f0b25c47e0642bf2e4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b4bee88d9a54e69a1a11d14990d894b016f0a180.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Baron"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I bring you a historical gem: an aircraft that's extremely rare in the world of video games, the "[b]Baron[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]You'll say, "What the hell are you talking about? That name doesn't exist!"[/p][p]You're right, in fact, its real name is Fokker Dr.I... does that mean anything to you?[/p][p]Probably not, that's understandable.[/p][p]What if I said "Red Baron"?[/p][p]If that doesn't mean anything to you either, please go back to playing soccer video games!!![/p][p][/p][p]As many of you know, the Red Baron was a German flying ace in World War I! He flew his legendary Fokker Dr.I, painted completely red, hence the name.[/p][p][/p][p]The Fokker Dr.I was a fighter aircraft, and that's precisely what it will be in the game, where it'll be armed with two 7.62 mm machine guns that the pilot can use.[/p][p]Now, many will come to my house with pitchforks to tell me that wasn't the original caliber, but, as I've answered others, I'm combining weapons and vehicles from over a century of military history belonging to different countries, and therefore with completely different calibers. For my own sanity, I'm trying to group as many calibers as possible into a few categories to manage the game's balance better.[/p][p][/p][p]Returning to the Baron, it will be a triplane fighter, very light, with a low cruising speed and a strong will to win![/p][p]As a World War I aircraft, and considering the advanced technology of the F-22 in the game, I need to characterize it in a way that doesn't render it entirely useless for the player.[/p][p]For this reason, it will be the first unlockable fighter and therefore the cheapest to call into battle.[/p][p]It won't be able to compete against more modern aircraft, but it will be a good option for taking down bombers from its era and even for taking down some unarmored ground enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to comment below.[/p][p]See you at the next MEET![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/100d673a5c52d77f22e9b202919679a0e7da8baa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/a75edb82c43f32357ca6ada8b9743750e5ef14b8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/e3083f6efe4288459e33aa14575d6ac522a5a8d3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f5ea68a1b9c0590f34fe673b1f5b8549b325986b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/74fda730f9726a7ffd2363070b819965fd3c8f09.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b00279bb0eb27e444fe11f58c32cb74a9da266cf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ba4b38c04939b22b5d7dbeb70b58e12fda3a9f00.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the SBM-2 "Shark"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, my brothers in arms![/p][p]Today, I take you beneath the icy ocean waves, into the presence of one who feeds on salt and steel: the [b]SBM-2 "Shark"[/b] submarine![/p][p][/p][p]Military history buffs will immediately notice how much this model recalls the military submarines of World War II, and indeed, it is inspired by them.[/p][p]When technology was still secondary to human courage, the intrepid sailors who sailed the depths in the belly of this metallic monster laid the foundations for a new type of warfare: submarine warfare.[/p][p][/p][p]Underwater battles are much slower and more strategic than surface battles, where every submarine and every ship is a piece in a great chess game.[/p][p]In my game, I'm trying to convey this abysmal slowness, this alternate passage of time, where the soldier will be enveloped in solitude and darkness, but it won't be that easy, as it will be part of a much faster gameplay.[/p][p]As always, I'll do my best![/p][p][/p][p]The Shark is a large submarine with two crew members.[/p][p]Don't be fooled by the fact that it's "vintage," otherwise you'll soon be joining the fish.[/p][p]The helmsman will be in command of the vessel and will be able to launch the fearsome torpedoes from six launch tubes. Furthermore, he will have a dual 12.7 mm machine gun, designed primarily for anti-aircraft defense (yes, there are torpedo bombers too!), but also very useful for dispatching small surface enemies.[/p][p]The second crew member will also have the same machine gun, located on the rear, and a powerful 105 mm cannon. Obviously, this weapon won't be able to fire while submerged, but it will prove to be a powerful weapon against surface targets, such as small ships, boats, and hostile marine life. It could also prove excellent for sinking larger ships if they're already dead and you want to save your precious torpedoes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Speaking of torpedoes![/b][/p][p]This game features several types of torpedoes, from the more classic to the more technologically advanced; the type of torpedo carried will depend on the type of vessel.[/p][p]In this case, the Shark carries classic torpedoes, the slow and inexorable ones that only move in the direction they are launched.[/p][p]Although they lack autonomous target-finding capabilities, they have the great advantage of being inexpensive, which means they can be transported in large numbers before returning to refuel.[/p][p][/p][p]In "Home Wars: Battlefield," there will be several types of submarines, including strategic ones for hitting land targets, but these will be revealed gradually as development progresses.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, enjoy these preview images and share your thoughts and suggestions in the comments.[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD WATER BUG IS A DEAD WATER BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/a7c84e8107f54f98f33f7e729bade155c4fcd498.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bf711b50818a5697431fc270f4cb0d506e20aab8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/5cc12139a875774971b0d79380030327c1be149e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/0abeb52a3c7bbca59266986117cab6e67fca84d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/64566695ef7e51b9f02e0bceb79fad97e977473f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/fe19f9ea8e3a7128ce06c9e10367878cc08517aa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/1252fa230b769b9aeeeee208495e8235ab5ce50c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f214eba69414014db58744629956b505c5654b99.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the Assault Mech MH-1 "Prometheus"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today is starting to feel a bit sci-fi, but squashing insects requires firepower beyond the ordinary![/p][p]Introducing the [b]MH-1 "Prometheus" Assault Mech[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This mech is designed to assault enemy lines conventionally and without frills![/p][p]Two crew members operate it:[/p][p]- The first, in addition to being the pilot, has two 12.7 mm rotating machine guns, excellent for faster targets, and two large pods containing 127 mm high-explosive rockets. For now, I'm undecided about using the pods for two different types of ammunition.[/p][p]- The second is responsible for ensuring a secure perimeter for the vehicle; he can count on a quad 7.62 mm machine gun and two small pods containing 20 mm rockets.[/p][p][/p][p]One of this beast's most significant advantages is also one of its greatest weaknesses: its height.[/p][p]This provides excellent visibility on the battlefield, allowing it to target enemies hiding behind cover. However, it can also be hit by enemies far away, creating a large enough silhouette to be easily hit.[/p][p][/p][p]I already have a series of classes of this type of mech ready, such as an anti-tank version, an anti-aircraft version, and an anti-infantry version, among others.[/p][p]I've also prepared 3D models of some "vehicles" that are neither mechs nor exosuits, but something in between.[/p][p][/p][p]I dedicate this mech to the memory of the "big chickens" from BF2142, one of the best games of all time.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions, please feel free to write and I'll be happy to answer them :)[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c9c300281304b90d92440872b9facb97dd761852.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/7cdec87862589a8f8804459f906334e2a27f121b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/e6d42889438d76404810e90947ddf7330ea8131d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bd1c6dd5221921bfff664643d3e5b40ab318237b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6957766b38311cb967df7c451730a68a390f50ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/535a7014d00a9a1f8a46e6d72a70c92e612f9b35.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/22fb6c2c53622944c4853a0bd317953afa7d84d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b3f90a3f7ffe171825dbac737b55e0ef39ebf1bc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Aedes albopictus"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, we're switching sides and analyzing one of our future adversaries: the "[b]Aedes albopictus[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]The Aedes albopictus, also known as the tiger mosquito, is a tiny insect, as small as it is annoying.[/p][p]Mosquitoes generally strike at night, but not these! They're so brazen that they strike during the day, in plain sight, confident in their superiority and driven by their insatiable thirst for human blood![/p][p]Just think, the Aedes albopictus is among the 100 most harmful invasive species in the world.[/p][p]How many beautiful summer afternoons have been ruined by the arrival of a pack of these damned creatures that started tearing your legs apart?[/p][p]But now, thanks to HWB, you can repay them some of the pain they suffered, even if only virtually.[/p][p][/p][p]In the game, the Aedes albopictus are slow-flying insects with little resistance to enemy attacks.[/p][p]"A walk in the park," you might say, but it's not![/p][p]This insect's attack is powerful compared to its resistance; it can also regenerate health after each successful attack. Of course, it's not a solitary animal, so when you spot it, it'll most likely be within a formation of Aedes albopictus, which becomes very dangerous in groups.[/p][p][/p][p]To counter this creature, all you need are arm weapons, good aim (because they're thin), and medium-low anti-aircraft armaments. Forget the more sophisticated anti-aircraft guns; those are best for hornets, jets, and pterodactyls![/p][p][/p][p]If you want to play as these infamous creatures, know that speed isn't your best bet.[/p][p]Stay out of sight of the enemy as much as possible, and then, when you're close enough, hit them as many times as you can, perhaps moving in circles.[/p][p]In fact, if you think about it, in gameplay, you should be just as annoying as they are to us![/p][p][/p][p]In the photos below, I've quickly simulated what a group attack on a poor soldier might look like.[/p][p][b]Do you think the soldier would have died or not?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p]( ... these are annoying even to death because they leave a blood stain on your fingers and you have to wash them afterwards!)"[/p][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b3d0c094c79aa8a6ee1da468f0312a8bf7026df3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/4311f3a72f59089c51bd5e163f3aad20f264d924.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6331cd1cb354ae61cfe6b7e573e99ef4fa3212af.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/7cb9542e1d21d8d1c9cbcea7a50974c5d771a769.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/9236fa81cdec414bc91ffde853ee11860316d7eb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bc7a531228354ba32f9cb5c4ba1ac9fe644f2689.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c00800906175496a1f17242b965b028f0ca96f27.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "F-14 Mav"!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development [/b](ADD it to your WISHLIST):[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I bring you my favorite aircraft of all time (and I'm sure others will agree).[/p][p]Today, I present to you the legendary "[b]F-14 Mav[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]Of course, I can't use the original names, but I tried to get as close as possible to retain the spirit of that movie we all loved![/p][p][/p][p]The F-14 was born as an interceptor and was widely used by the Navy.[/p][p]Its strengths, besides its aesthetics (which makes me feel like a teenager at my favorite boy band concert every time I see it), were its powerful engines, a highly advanced radar, and above all, its armament.[/p][p]This aircraft's AA missiles had an insane range for its time, which could lead to its enemies being destroyed before they even knew of the existence of good old "Tommy."[/p][p][/p][p]In my game, I tried to maintain the "sacredness" I have for this aircraft, without forcing it to be the best of all the others (and I tell you, there are SO MANY!).[/p][p]In translating our Mav from reality to the video game, I ran into a significant problem: in the front, there's the pilot, who's incredibly cool, we all know that, but in the back, there's another crew member... what the hell do I make the second crew member do???[/p][p]In reality, he was in charge of managing the powerful radar and maintaining communications, but in my game, this made no sense.[/p][p]So that amazing BF3 mission aboard the plane comes in handy![/p][p]Reworking the idea a bit, the second crew member will have additional AA missiles at his disposal and will be able to lock onto enemies independently, obviously taking into account the trajectory of his own plane.[/p][p][/p][p]Both crew members will have a certain number of missiles, likely of different power and different locking methods. One of these two missiles will be unique to the F-14 Mav (this is my little tribute to the king) and will have the greatest range and power compared to the other AA missiles. Obviously, even more powerful missiles can be launched from the ground. The pilot will also be able to use a 20mm rotary cannon, great for close-in enemies and when the cool missiles run out![/p][p][/p][p][b]In short:[/b] the Mav will be an interceptor fighter, therefore geared exclusively for air superiority.[/p][p]It can have two crew members, both with offensive capabilities and health insurance![/p][p]What are the king of the skies' main enemies?[/p][p]Definitely ground-based anti-aircraft, although it will also be able to rely on flares.[/p][p]Furthermore, fast units like flies, dragonflies, and the most modern stealth aircraft, which missiles can't lock on to, could give it a hard time.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, and tell all your friends, because I'm trying to include so many units and vehicles that it will take you weeks to test them all![/p][p][/p][p][b]PS:[/b] In the photos below, you will also find a very accurate, high-definition reconstruction of the most famous scene from the film that we all love.[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8845fa72e6af50473db6fdb2fddeaed0dc4a69b1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c7fcad1e177575965c7ec2cea6a9f0ccf7d09931.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/028c725fa9d6425c4d7348991201ae2f91defad4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6ddbd559b0eb09210383e8015c61eece870330f8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6d1aeed519c104e84e6832d6beb06c4ae5b73ee9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c962aed089f2d7904033a489d4c8e033365793cd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b8b328d7e421ac296e19ad23dcff70554f1435bb.png"][/img][/p]

[p]Hello, Generals![/p][p align="start"]Hoping you'll enjoy it, I'm sharing the news just released about [b]my new co-op multiplayer FPS game "Home Wars: Battlefield" in development[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p]"Hello, my brave soldiers![/p][p align="start"]Today, I present to you an aircraft that I hope will give you an idea of ​​the breadth of gameplay and the complexity of development of this game: the "[b]Kingfisher[/b]"![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]There came a point in human history when ships no longer mastered the vast ocean surfaces and began to feel vulnerable. From fearless battleships, they gradually became small, high-tech vessels.[/p][p align="start"]When did the nobility of armor give way to the cowardice of agility?[/p][p align="start"]This point was when someone first thought of loading a torpedo onto an airplane.[/p][p align="start"]A torpedo bomber combines the incredible agility and speed of an airplane with the extreme lethality of a torpedo.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The Kingfisher is a biplane equipped with a single, powerful torpedo.[/p][p align="start"]Your attack tactic is simple to understand, but not so easy to execute. Its pilot must get within a few meters of the water's surface, calculate the target's speed and direction, and release the torpedo at the optimal moment. All this must be done while anti-aircraft fire is pounding you, enemy fighters are targeting you, and your target is taking evasive maneuvers.[/p][p align="start"]However, you have a small advantage: you can bring along a second crew member who is "supposed" to help you against enemy fighters using a 7.62mm machine gun and perhaps by identifying your most suitable targets.[/p][p align="start"]Furthermore, with only one torpedo, you'll have to refuel after each attack.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]You can see why playing as a torpedo bomber is more of a calling than a choice. However, the satisfaction of watching steel beasts go down thanks to a well-organized squadron of friends is priceless.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]I already have graphics for other torpedo bombers from various eras, including helicopters![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Can you tell me which aircraft this 3D model was taken from?[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!"[/h3][p][/p][p]This is the link to the new game, add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b]:[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28947868/1a71c852850478f9baffb56dd87027e49de88b00.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28947868/1cd5cc4fab744e6eef366d215d72b998a547defe.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28947868/aff19411a16206673ccfca567fe3c962c62f838b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28947868/be197d43da198208543195abb0b57e2ef7aa2338.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28947868/58ab45e75e33d1ac4be85a7d85586fb4c4dc02eb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28947868/88a957b3ae496f9478087bf283a01cb89dd8d6e6.png"][/img][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279330/Home_Wars_Battlefield?snr=1_5_9_"]

notes.title: Update to version 1.036!
notes.notes:
Hello, Generals!

In these months, you have pointed out to me that the game has problems starting.
Initially I was not too worried, because I know that this problem has always existed, but it affected very few players and I also never understood how to solve it, because I can never replicate it on my machines.
However, since I updated the game engine (Unity) in the hope of improving the experience for all users, I noticed that many more players were unable to start the game.

Even in this case, I could not replicate the problem on my computers, but something had to be done! I could not allow the hecatomb of insects to stop!

Consequently I opted for the most logical thing: [b]I brought Home Wars back to the original game engine, trying to maintain all the improvements I had made in the last updates.[/b]
It really took me a long time, but it was the right thing to do for those who believed in me and in this project.


[h3]CHANGES IN VERSION 1.036:[/h3]

- [b]The game engine has been brought back to 2017! We are back to Unity 5.4![/b]
I know it's always a paradox, but maybe it's the most stable way to play HW.
Let me know if you notice a performance degradation, thanks.

- [b]I tried to keep all the improvements of the latest updates[/b], but I definitely missed something, so if you notice it, let me know!

- I remember that some people complained about problems in the initial menu, I think they said they couldn't see/press some buttons.
[b]I made some changes to the anchors of the various screens[/b]; tell me if it's better or worse now, especially for those with resolutions other than 16:9.


I want to point out that this great effort does not bring me any significant economic advantage, perhaps a few fewer refunds.
I did it because before being a developer, I am a gamer, or rather I would say a super gamer!
I know what it means to have your smile fade because of a game that does not start, which is why, for me, this type of problem has priority in being solved.

[b]I take this opportunity to remind you to stay tuned with the news, because I am working assiduously on the new "Home Wars: Battlefield", even if I am encountering several problems in the development of the multiplayer component, which however I absolutely want to include.[/b]


The war against insects continues, my friends, and we are certainly not the ones to give up!

[h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3]

notes.title: Start of development "HOME WARS: BATTLEFIELD" + survey!
notes.notes:
"Gooooood morning, Vietnaaaam!"

Here we are!!!

[b]Finally finally finally finally back to developing a new chapter of the Home Wars universe![/b]

A few days ago I started developing the new Home Wars: Battlefield and I must say that the warrior spirit of when I developed the first title has returned to me.

I want to point out that this game will not be a "Home Wars 2", but will be a separate chapter, totally focused on battles!

Below are some questions and answers to clarify your ideas.


[h3]WHY A CHAPTER FOCUSED ONLY ON BATTLES?[/h3]
There are mainly two reasons:
1) Developing HW2 would take me too long and now I can't afford it financially.
2) I would like to develop the battlefield part well and then transfer everything to the future HW2 and save some time.
Furthermore, I have the opportunity to test some totally new features compared to HW1.

[h3]WHAT NEW FEATURES WILL BE PRESENT?[/h3]
1) There will be (I hope) at least [b]3 factions[/b]: the toy soldiers, the insects and... mystery!
2) I'm working hard to introduce [b]multiplayer[/b]! It's my dream to develop a battlefield-style game, but [b]PvE[/b], I just hope the networking supports more than 4 players.
Obviously, single-player mode will also be available.
3) [b]Naval battles[/b]!
4) All factions will be [b]playable[/b]!
5) The toy soldiers will have movement animations; no more pedestals!
6) Translations into many languages.


[h3]SURVEY:[/h3]
This is the first of a series of surveys that I will propose to you to create gameplay as close as possible to your tastes, so stay connected for future surveys.
Reply many!

[b]1)[/b] If I could develop multiplayer successfully, do you think 4 players would be enough?
Obviously, the 4 (or more) players would be part of a much larger army, I hope almost 100 vs 100.

[b]2)[/b] At least at the beginning, I would prefer to implement open maps, like islands, and then maybe later, I could create some home maps.
There won't be a workshop, sorry, but it's too long to implement, but everything you want to include in the game, I can create it! :)

[b]3)[/b] Friendly fire or not? I say in multiplayer.

[b]4)[/b] Do you want the insect faction to be "realistic" like HW1 or a little more fantasy like Helldivers 2?

[b]5)[/b] What factions would you like besides soldiers and insects?

[b]6)[/b] Is it a problem if there are no animations such as reloading weapons?
As you know, I'm a solo developer, and making tiny animations like reloading weapons would take up a lot of my time. Plus, they won't be as nice as other games.
I thought the soldier could lower the weapon long enough to reload and then return to the firing position.
I can't use external animations because my models are designed to have as few bones as possible in the animations so as to improve performance and maybe insert more bots to create more chaos!

[b]7)[/b] The basic idea would be that the player starts with few choices when it comes to battle, but by collecting experience, he will be able to unlock each unit (vehicles, aircraft, ships, submarines, insects and who knows what! :D)
What do you think?
In this way, the game loses some of the immediacy of the gameplay but gains considerable longevity (I love unlocking things in video games)!


[b]I hope you have read everything; reply in large numbers because it is very important for me to know your opinion![/b]

When I have something to show you, I will publish the game page on Steam.

[b]Stay tuned![/b]

[b]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A F*****G DEAD BUG!!![/b]

notes.title: New HOME WARS! Do you prefer HW: COMMANDO or HW: BATTLEFIELD???
notes.notes:
Hello Generals!!!

[b]Finally, I can go back to developing a new Home Wars![/b]

As much as I would like to develop "Home Wars 2" right away, that's not possible at the moment.

[h3]Why can't I develop Home Wars 2 now?[/h3]
HW is a game composed of 3 different gameplay styles, namely turn-based strategy, real-time strategy, and first/third-person shooter.
As you understand, it is an extremely long and complex project to develop, especially with all the fantastic ideas that you have suggested and which I will include.

[h3]Is there another reason why I'm not developing Home Wars 2 yet?[/h3]
I would like HW2 to have many new features. Among these are a physics-based system, naval units, playing as an insect, being able to play soldiers against soldiers, and much more.
All these features are risky to insert them all together for the first time, because they risk ruining the rest of the game.
Solution? I thought about introducing them gradually, one game at a time, so as to arrive at HW2 with the right experience to better integrate them and make a "definitive" Home Wars!

[h3]What are the options?[/h3]
I have two projects in mind to start testing the new features:
- [b]Home Wars: COMMANDO[/b]
- [b]Home Wars: BATTLEFIELD[/b]

[h3]What is Home Wars: COMMANDO?[/h3]
HW Commando is a sort of "Yet Another Zombie Survivors" set in the world of Home Wars.
There will be very different mechanics, also because I want to insert a sort of campaign linked to the neighborhood and not just to a single house.
There will be lots of weapons, lots of Helldivers style mounts (no code to enter) and most likely vehicles too.
I had already started developing this title, but I had to stop to finish the development of my latest game "Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood".

[h3]What is Home Wars: BATTLEFIELD?[/h3]
HW Battlefield is, just to give you an idea, a sort of "Ravenfield" set in the world of Home Wars, but with maps not necessarily linked only to domestic environments.

notes.title: SLOW RETURN TO NORMALITY
notes.notes:
Hello, my friends!

Since I published the news about the flood I suffered, I have received more interest (likes and comments) than any update made in recent years!

[b]This made me extremely happy and made me understand that in addition to the developer-player bond, there is a bit of love <3[/b]

For this reason, I want to work even harder to make sure that in the future, when you open one of my games, you will feel it more fun, warmer, and with the feeling that it was developed by one of you!



[h3]FLOOD REPORT:[/h3]

If you are interested in getting some images of what happened, search for "Campi Bisenzio flood 2023".

The situation has not yet returned to normal, but the water has receded from almost every area and most of the mud has been taken away to allow road transport, so the first conclusions of this disaster can be drawn.

Eight people have died, hundreds of families are currently homeless, and the damage is calculated in the order of hundreds of millions of euros.



[h3]HOW DID IT HAPPEN?[/h3]

When storm Ciaran hit Tuscany on November 2, 2023, the rain began to fall with rare violence.
I remember I was out with my dog, and I was talking to my mother on my cell phone when the rain started hitting the umbrella with such force that we couldn't hear each other anymore, not even screaming.

Statistics say that two months' worth of rain fell in just two hours...
I honestly don't know if it's true, but I guarantee you that a lot... a lot... has fallen.

Many towns in the Florence-Prato-Pistoia plain were flooded simultaneously and by different rivers, a sign that the quantity of water on the ground was truly unmanageable.

In my town, Campi Bisenzio, the rivers have both burst their banks and overflowed.
Many areas were inundated with more than 150 cm of water.
In the case of my house, the water did not exceed 50 cm, but it was the most affected by the mud, as an old wall broke in at least 3 points, completely letting the water flow out.

In my street, we found ourselves having to shovel like 30 cm of mud everywhere in the house, garden and street.
I'm not a thin guy, but I guarantee you that wet mud weighs a lot, especially if you don't sleep at night and if the humidity gets into your bones, day after day.



[h3]WHAT DID I SEE THAT I DIDN'T EXPECT TO SEE?[/h3]

I saw a lot of solidarity.
Honestly, with the way the world is going, I didn't expect to see so many people willing to roll up their sleeves to help other people from nearby countries.
We received the help of thousands of volunteers of all ages, who made themselves available to shovel the mud, to bring basic necessities and to finance these operations.

I also saw absurdly comical scenes like a group of volunteers trying to clear out an underground garage with buckets... without realizing that the water came back under their feet every time :D

Unfortunately, there have also been many episodes that make you lose all hope for the human race, such as the fact that there have been looting actions, that there have been thefts of food items intended for flood victims and that cars have been stolen pretending to be emergency units.



[h3]EFFECTS ON THE BODY?[/h3]

Talking with the other inhabitants of my area, I discovered these consequences, some obvious, others curious:
- common back pain due to moving weights.
- intense pain in hands and feet due to continuous contact with water; we are talking about at least 7 days.
- difficulty sleeping in the rain.
- feeling of nausea when you hear water flowing, whether it is a small stream or a high-pressure washer.

In my case, having been the only one able to clean the house for many days, I now find myself with a fixed backache. I have no strength in my hands, and as soon as it becomes evening, I get constant pain inside the bones of my hands and feet, so much so that it is impossible for me to return to sports for at least another week.



[h3]WHAT HAPPENS NOW?[/h3]

I can finally go back to work most hours of the day now, even if it will take another week to finish the cleaning.



[h3]WHAT ARE THE ONGOING PROJECTS?[/h3]

Just to summarize, in addition to updating the games already released, there are 2 projects I'm currently working on:

- [b]"Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood" has already been released but is still in Early Access[/b]. In particular, I must add the Story mode, which enriches the gameplay and justifies the battles.

- [b]A Battlefield-style game, but single-player, with both first-person and tactical components, as in BF2 and BF4.
I tell Home Wars lovers to follow this latest title (not yet available) in the future because, among the factions present, there will also be insects and perhaps even dinosaurs! Both as enemies and as fully playable units![/b]
Furthermore, I will need this game to test some dynamics that I would like to introduce in HW2, such as physics and first-person in the invertebrate units.

In reality, I have a thousand other ideas, but being a single developer, it's very difficult to manage everything, so I'm forced to nip some very cool ideas in the bud, perhaps hoping to realize them in the future.



[h3]DO YOU WANT TO SUPPORT ME?[/h3]

Do you know those developers who managed to become millionaires with a single game (due to skill and luck)? ... well, it's not me! :D

[b]If you want to support me, there are 3 ways:[/b]

- Check out my latest games and see if there's any you're interested in!
Please buy for your own pleasure and not out of compassion for what just happened to me. Ultimately, I received very little damage compared to other families affected by the flood.

- If you like one of my games, it would be great if you left a review to encourage other potential players to purchase!

- Good old word of mouth!
I certainly can't invest in advertising now, so good word of mouth would be very helpful to me at this moment <3



[h3]CONCLUSION:[/h3]

What doesn't kill you strengthens you... but it tires you out a lot... :D

[b]I REALLY thank you from the bottom of my heart for being close to me at this moment, and I promise that I will try to reciprocate this love with healthy fun in the months/years to come![/b]

Talk to you in the next updates, my dear keyboard friends! <3

notes.title: The toy soldiers in our childhood
notes.notes:
Hello, Generals!
As I mentioned in the last post, I'd like to exchange our childhood experiences related to the world of toy soldiers.

This is not an update, and it's not an advertisement for my new games, it's just a chat with friends.

I'll start and, if you like, tell your story <3

How did I start?
The first to buy me the packs of toy soldiers was my father, of course.
It was he who passed on to me this great passion for the military world, who explained to me the first tactics used by real Generals, and who told me anecdotes that still make me dream 30 years later.
I don't remember exactly which one was the first, but I remember the places where he gradually bought them for me; most often, it happened in the summer when we were on vacation by the sea.
Here in Italy, I don't know abroad, usually in every package there are two-colored soldiers: green and grey. The former represents the Americans and the latter the Germans, as they almost always represent World War 2.

Where did I play?
The place where I played it the most was undoubtedly my maternal grandmother's table! A huge table (looking at it now, it's not that huge :D ) where I put the gray soldiers on the left and the green ones on the right.
Usually, first I prepared the base of the gray ones, which I think also had a few more cannons, then the green ones, which instead had more variety of infantry ... typical things for children's games :D

Particular units?
I also remember that since there wasn't all the military variety I wanted, I used Lego to build planes, spaceships, and heavy tanks. I also seem to have used some GI Joe as a hero just to break through enemy lines.
For the air units, I used another package which, however, had small planes, absolutely not in scale with the toy soldiers, but which, together with the film Top Gun made me dream! The F-14 Tomcat remains my favorite aircraft and always will be!
I also had some unlikely underwater soldiers, but I never knew how to use them in battle :D so I ended up creating totally unrealistic underwater battles, haha, but somehow I had to use them.
I also had dinosaurs, but I don't think I ever used them in these battles. A childhood without dinosaurs is no childhood!

What tactics did I use?
Contrary to what you may think, I don't like complex strategies.
I've always liked breaking through enemy lines with brute force, maybe with artillery and tanks. It makes me smile that I still prefer this way of doing strategy games that I can play in my little free time.

Who did I win?
Since green is a more positive color than gray, I generally let them win, regardless of the nationality they represented, but it could happen that sometimes the gray soldiers massacred the green ones, and then the immediate revenge started! :D

Conclusions.
The years in which I have been able to play toy soldiers have been the best of my life so far, not only because of them of course, but because it is a period of life in which you mostly see the good in the world and ignore the bad.
That way of playing has developed a lot of imagination in me, a lot of passion for the military world, even though I reject war as an instrument of attack.
When I remember those moments, I also feel that plastic on my fingers (typically very low quality plastic!), the sensation of my grandmother's tablecloth which in the summer used to stick to my little chubby forearms :D and the smell of food I pour lunchtime came out of the kitchen.

This is kind of my story :)
I'd be curious to hear yours <3
How were the toy soldiers in your countries? what tactics did you use? How did you get interested in the military world?

See you soon, my friends!

notes.title: Message to all Generals!
notes.notes:
Hi guys, we've seen the last announcement has created a bit of confusion and bitterness among some of you. We're sorry for the misunderstanding and we'll like to clarify some things with you:

1) The announcement for Multicellular wasn't posted as a "Home Wars Update" in order to deceive you (as some say), but simply to advertise our latest product on a platform that already knows us.
If you have received the announcement as an update, we are sorry, but Steam provides only one feature to create announcements, whether they are updates or news.

2) Home Wars will no longer be updated. As we have said many times before, we're a really small team and we couldn't develop a new game while updating a really complex one like Home Wars.

3) Home Wars is a finished game (and many players have confirmed that both in private chat and comments)! Sure it has some bugs, but is totally playable. Home Wars didn't come out in early access, so there were no promises to keep, as it will be for Multicellular, which will be released in early access. When a player, including us, buys a video game that's not in early access on Steam, he/she knows exactly what is buying, thanks to trailers, screenshots, gameplay, reviews, comments and other tools. The developer does not have any kind of obligation towards the player; the updates the team releases will improve the gaming experience, but they are not mandatory!

4) Home Wars is absolutely not a "cash grab" as someone has defined it, and this definition hurts us enormously. Before being developers, we are players and we want to make something funny for you. Unfortunately, developers do not live on dreams, but they need money, just like you do; for this reason, there are parameters that "force" a team of developers to create a new project and to abandon the old one, even though they love it.

5) Home Wars was our first real game, so it has its flaws. We are self-taught, but we are learning quickly because this world thrills us! Seeing you happy is incredibly motivating! The way Home Wars was realized, makes it not suitable for complex transformations like a multiplayer feature. We evolved while working and it's unthinkable to rewrite all the codes from the beginning.  

6) Multicellular is our first experiment with the multiplayer feature (which we love), that's why we prefer to release it in early access, so it can grow together with you. Remember that we are learning, but we need funds to do it ... May sound strange but even developers eat and need a roof over their heads.

7) We consider the early access as a promise to the player, that's why we'll develop Multicellular to make it perfectly playable, with your help; and we'll try to update it after the release. Surely there will be unsatisfied players, but it's impossible to please everyone.

8) Multicellular will be released within a month from today, perhaps less, and will be available in 8 languages, so many players around the world will be able to enjoy it.


In this world nobody is perfect! The only thing that human beings can do is to try to get better day by day, and we’re doing it.

If we have disappointed some of you, we are awfully sorry. For those who still want to support us ... the journey continues!

Thanks for the time you have spent to read this post.

See you next time, our trusted Generals! :)

We are continuing to update the game because we want to win this damn war!
Here are the news that this update brings:

- As many of you have asked, we have implemented the possibility to deploy groups of units!

- The Sapper is a very special unit, but it’s often overpowered.
We have tried to balance it by increasing the cost of its buildings and modifying some variables.
We also need your feedback on this fix, so let us know how it goes. 

- We have increased by a little the hitbox of the following enemies:
Formica fusca
Solenopsis invicta

If you like the game, please review it on our store page; we need it.
Thanks Generals!

notes.notes:

- As many of you have asked, we have improved the navigation of all units (it wasn't a bug, but a bad optimization). Now your troops will respond to your orders better and faster.

- Many players reported us they couldn't hit some insects. Actually they got hit but didn't give you the feedback if the bullet hit their heads. However now this bug is solved.

- As many people have asked, now, the middle mouse button rotates the camera.

- Minor bugs have been fixed.

- The sound of the 81mm Cannons of the Spitlead has been changed.

- Some players have asked us to increase the lenght of the battle; for this reason we have tried to do so for 2 missions:
"Defend the allied Outpost"
"Destroy the enemy Outpost".

- We have increased the Health Points of:
Long Range Bomber
Strategic Bomber
Gunship
Spitlead.

- Some of you complained that the Ant Swarm hit them too early in the Campaign. For this reason we have decreased slightly the external Rotten Food and the Rotten Food gained from battles.

- Another "bug" that you have reported us is that soldiers can't shoot on very close enemies.
They could do it! You have to select the 4th behavior of the unit in order to set it to shoot to the closest enemy (IF they don't already have a target).
Now we'll set this behaviour as a default one for some infantry.
Vehicles and some heavy infantry can't attack very close enemies, but it's normal (a tank can't shoot a target that's one metre away from it), so their default behavior remains the 3rd one.

- Now some aircraft units will look for a target automatically, by default:
Strike Aircraft
Ground-Attack Aircraft
Interceptor Aircraft
Fighter Aircraft.
In the next update we'll implement the possibility to enable or disable this feature in Settings/Game.
However now you can disable it manually from the unity box, in the battle.

Generals, we haven't started this War, but we are going to end it!
Let's send them to Hell!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.004
notes.notes:
Hi Generals!

With this update we hope to solve the launch-crash problem that some of you had.
It's probably a resolution error and this update should solve it.

If you continue to have this problem, please try to:
- set a lower video quality than the current video quality, in the screen before the game launch.
- run the game as admin (right-click on the Home Wars icon on Desktop and then press "run as admin").
- add the game (the whole folder of the game and the process Home Wars.exe) to you antivirus' exclusions list.
- if it's not the first time you run the game, uninstall it and then reinstall it to make sure you don't have corrupted files.

Some computers make take longer to launch the game (even 2 minutes) due to the graphics card, especially on the first launch, so please just wait. If you get the Windows "Program is not responding..." screen, press "Wait for the program to respond".

We apologize for the inconvenience and we hope this update will solve the problem.
Let us know if it works.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

notes.title: DEVELOPERS' TIPS #1 - "First steps to Hell"
notes.notes:
Hello Generals!
How are you?
Are you doing your part in this bloody War?

We know you are veteran commanders, but today we want to give you some advices on how to face the first days of the Campaign.

1) Recruit 2-3 armies made of only one Light Rifleman and make them conquer as many empty rooms (white flags) as possible.

2) The industries are the backbone of your Army, so build as soon as possible a Plastic Factory, a Metal Factory and a Power Station. After that you should increase the number of Plastic Factories and start to build 1-2 Academies.

3) Your first unlock should be the Supply Truck, because without it your soldiers will remain out of ammo on the battlefield and they won't be healed.

4) Rush quickly to the enemy rooms. The Enemy needs 3 turns to conquer your room, so you can use this time to produce resources for the armies.

5) Don't enter the mission "Destroy the enemy Outpost" if you don't have any Sappers, artillery or bombers.
The Sapper is always a great soldier! Use it to place dynamite in the enemy outpost (it has to be very close to the outpost to place explosives).

6) Dont't enter the mission "Conquer the flags" if you don't have a good army, because it will be a carnage.

7) Every troop on the battlefield has a behaviour that you can change in the "unit's box" (bottom-left of the screen).
All units, except planes, start with the 3th behavior.
The planes use very expensive weapons, so they will attack ONLY if you order them so; however you can modify their behaviour too.

8) Use the Supply Truck to supply and heal your troops! A battle without supply units is a lost battle.

9) Press "Q" to use a unit (Soldier Mode) and press "E" (when you are in Soldier Mode) to use the special view of that unit (if it has one).

10) Every weapon has a range of fire; if the enemy is out of this range, your unit can't hit it!
If you are using your unit in Soldier Mode, you can hit enemies only if they are in your range of fire. You can check this in the "weapon box" (bottom-left of the screen).

11) READ THE MANUAL!!!


Thanks Generals for your attention!
Bugs are invading our homes and we can't allow that! You must react now!
Remember brothers: the only good bug is a dead bug!
Burn them all!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.002
notes.notes:
Hi Generals!
This is the second update of Home Wars, and here are the changes:

- The dynamite sound bug has been solved

- In Settings/Game you can now customize the plane's pilot sensitivity and invert the vertical axis. This setting can not be changed during the battle.

- As many of you have asked, we have increased the maximum limit of units that you can use in the battle.
Now the limits are:
200 for the Allies
1000 for Bugs
As a result, the allies/bugs ratio in the Campaign has also changed, so update your Settings /Game/max units.

- In the Campaign, the experience at the end of the battle is no longer 20 Exp, but is proportional to the quality and quantity of the killed enemies.
Bloody battle = more Experience!

- As you have asked, the time span between the beginning of the battle and the beginning of the enemy spawn, it has been increased.

- The Sapper turned out to be overpowered, so from now on it won't be able to place its structures near enemies.

Generals do your part! Protect your homes!
Good luck!
